methods.failed_witness: The initial x1 portfolio used the field name planning_state with future target dispositions, creating an avoidable risk that a planning document could be read as x2 outcome evidence.
methods.bounded_recovery: An additive x1-only repair renames exactly 195 keys to expected_execution_disposition, preserves every value and credit boundary, and changes no proposal, task, approval, or expected outcome.
methods.passing_witness: The repaired portfolio contains zero planning_state keys, 195 expected_execution_disposition keys, 95 completed targets, and 100 represented targets, all explicitly prospective.
methods.recurrence_guard: Reserve outcome and planning-state collector keys for observed evidence; use explicit expected-disposition fields in planning-only portfolios.
methods.rollback: The original x1 commit remains ancestral and recoverable; no history is rewritten.
